title: Give OLY-B-S2-01 a prompt-surface inventory mechanism and test
summary: Add reproducible code in the study capability that inventories every prompt surface of a studied instance, with a test on the real studies/ data. Record it as OLY-B-S2-01's mechanism, with owner Athena and a measure ending `status: not shown` that names the test.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require cargo test, clippy and fmt to pass.
A test runs the inventory on the real studies data.
The requirement is enforced by a test, recorded in spec.toml.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal and audience: Athena's spec gap check and the verifier must be able to see that each studied instance has a prompt-surface inventory built by code, not by hand.

Code survey: read docs/spec.toml (OLY-B-S2-01 entry, mechanism = "none"), crates/athena-core/tests/study_instance_split.rs (model: a test over the real files plus a spec-entry check using parse_spec and measure_problem), crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs (the Capability impl; prompts in prompts/), records.rs, rules.rs and model.rs. Grep found no prompt-surface logic in crates/athena-cap-study or in studies/, so the producer must create it. Entry point is the study capability. Records validation: any new record or data file under crates/ must be covered by check_record_file, AnyRecord or the round-trip test; the producer should prefer no new record file. The property is measured directly by running the inventory over studies/<id>/ and asserting the result.

Existing code: extend crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs and rules.rs, and reuse the spec helpers parse_spec and measure_problem from athena-core as in crates/athena-core/tests/study_instance_split.rs. docs/spec.toml is modified but not created.

Design choice: the inventory is a pure function over an instance's files that lists prompt surfaces, deterministic and sorted, so running it twice gives the same output (the reproducibility). The current instance is firstmate-work-handling. The capability must not name any instance (see the S1-02 test).
The measure follows the S1-02 pattern: it names the test command and ends `status: not shown`, because that each later instance is actually inventoried is not visible in static files.
Mechanism text in spec.toml should name real paths. Tests go in athena-core/tests or in the unit tests of athena-cap-study, wherever they can import the code.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-S2-01 has mechanism naming an existing code path and test file (not "none"), owner "Athena", and a measure that names the test command and ends with `status: not shown`.
The diff adds a prompt-surface inventory function in crates/athena-cap-study/src that names no instance id, and the mechanism text in docs/spec.toml cites its path.

A new test runs the inventory twice over every real studies/<id>/ directory, asserts non-empty identical output, and asserts the spec entry has a real mechanism, the owner and the measure label. Run `cargo test` and check the test passes. The test must fail on a spec entry with mechanism "none" or an empty inventory (negative cases in the same test file).
`cargo test` passes, including the existing spec-gap and record round-trip tests.

out_of_scope: Studying new instances or editing existing studies/ data
Editing docs/decisions.md entries or anything under records/
departures: The requirement is vague and no prompt-analysis code exists, so design is open and acceptance odds are lower than the reference.
